title: 2-D Standard Deviation
text: Compute standard deviation of input or sequence of inputs, 5 inputs, 2 outputs, {Reset port} sets Reset event; {Running standard deviation} sets the track running standard deviation, {Find the standard deviation value over} sets the dimension along which standard deviation is computed Entire, {Dimension} sets the custom dimension, {Enable ROI processing} sets the compute standard deviation within a particular, {ROI type} sets the type of ROI, {ROI portion to process} sets the portion of ROI in which to calculate standard deviation Entire, {Output} sets the calculate standard deviation for individual or entire ROI Individual statistics for each, {Output flag indicating if ROI is within image bounds} enables Flag port and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: Input array vector | matrix | N-D - array

ports.name: ROI
ports.summary: Region of interest four-element vector | m -by-4 matrix | M -by- N matrix

ports.name: Label
ports.summary: Label matrix matrix of nonnegative integers

ports.name: Label Numbers
ports.summary: Label values of ROIs M -element vector

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Computed output standard deviation scalar | vector | matrix | N-D -array

params.name: Running standard deviation
params.values: Track running standard deviation off (default) | on

params.name: Reset port
params.values: Reset event None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample

params.name: Find the standard deviation value over
params.values: Dimension along which standard deviation is computed Entire input (default) | Each row | Each column | Specified dimension

params.name: Enable ROI processing
params.values: Compute standard deviation within a particular region off (default) | on

params.name: ROI type
params.values: Type of ROI Rectangles (default) | Lines | Label matrix | Binary mask

params.name: ROI portion to process
params.values: Portion of ROI in which to calculate standard deviation Entire ROI (default) | ROI perimeter

params.name: Output
params.values: Calculate standard deviation for individual or entire ROI Individual statistics for each ROI (default) | Single statistic for all ROIs

params.name: Output flag indicating if ROI is within image bounds
Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
